mapper.update: UPDATE t_mall_order SET order_status = 50, pay_status = 30, close_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND order_status = 10 AND deleted_flag = 0 AND expire_time <= NOW()

UPDATE t_mall_order SET pay_proof_url = #{payProofUrl}, pay_note = #{payNote}, pay_status = 15, order_status = 15 WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND order_status = 10 AND deleted_flag = 0 AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time > NOW())

UPDATE t_mall_order SET pay_status = 20, order_status = 20, pay_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND order_status = 15 AND deleted_flag = 0 AND pay_proof_url IS NOT NULL AND pay_proof_url != ''
UPDATE t_mall_order SET order_status = 50, pay_status = 30, close_time = NOW(), remark = #{remark} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND order_status = 15 AND deleted_flag = 0
